notes_for_human: Workaround that beat the historical block: careers.sig.com (Jibe/iCIMS platform) serves the FULL job description as schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD inside the static HTML even though the visible page is JS-rendered — curl + JSON-LD extraction works; plain rendered fetch does not. Both 2027 postings share the identical eligibility line (graduate with at least a bachelor's and start full-time by August 2028, i.e. class of 2028 or graduating seniors of 2027-28) and identical 'Visa sponsorship is available' language — notable since many quant firms do not sponsor interns. No salary figure is published on either posting (JSON-LD baseSalary is 0/UNAVAILABLE); housing is the only stated compensation item. Neither posting describes the interview/assessment process; SIG's poker/probability evaluation reputation could not be tied to any firm-domain text. Cooling-off: a '12-month reapply' figure appeared only in prep-site/aggregator search snippets (Finbound, Quantt), which the rules exclude — treat as unverified. The Strategy Developer posting cross-links a 2027 Trading System Engineering Internship at https://careers.sig.com/intern-co-op/jobs/10837 (not read).
